tasks.short: Develop and implement methods for assessing financial risk.

steps.what: Define assessment purpose, risk horizon, and permitted uses.
Extract historical exposures and reconcile balances, dates, currencies, and counterparty identifiers.
Choose risk measures, modelling assumptions, and treatment of missing or extreme observations.
Implement the method, calibrate parameters, and run sensitivity and historical performance tests.
Challenge model assumptions, test coverage, limitations, and suitability for intended decisions.
Approve the exact model version, limitations, and permitted use.
Install the approved version and record its configuration and effective date.

tasks.design: A versioned calculation framework on the {DATA_PLATFORM} reconciles {ERP} and {BANK} data, fits specified methods, and generates reproducible test evidence. A release flow in the {WORKFLOW} checks approval of the exact version before activation and retains the specification and review in the {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Source reconciliation, bespoke calculation files, and repeatable testing required substantial engineering. Selecting a defensible method still required expert judgement.
tasks.enabler_now: AI-assisted coding reduces the effort of building adapters, calculation scaffolds, and test packs. Established statistical methods and version controls provide the underlying capability.
tasks.still_hard: Sparse loss histories, changing markets, and model misuse remain difficult. Independent challenge and evidence of fitness for purpose cannot be generated from clean code alone.
tasks.human_edge: Recognising when a mathematically plausible model gives a misleading answer to the business question.

ambition.what: Pre-deal risk assessment for proposed supplier-financing arrangements.

tasks.altitude: The week shifts from rebuilding calculation files to comparing assumptions and challenging proposed transactions. No additional transaction approval rights are assumed.

reach.task: Design out-of-time validation and reproducible parameter estimation.
reach.learn: Data leakage, sample selection, uncertainty estimates, and versioned experiments.

evidence.claim: Specified risk calculations, parameter fitting, reconciliation, and regression tests can use deterministic code.
DataSnipper supports evidence extraction and financial checking with human review; this is adjacent capability, not risk-model validation.
The documented spreadsheet benchmark reports numerical failures, supporting independent arithmetic checks rather than unrestricted model-generated calculations.

assumptions: The baseline is a corporate finance risk function, rather than a regulated consumer lender.
Implementation uses a bounded library of established methods; novel methodology remains specialist work.
Estimates cover one model family and a pilot, excluding creation of a new enterprise data platform.
GDPR applies where personal data are used. EU AI Act applicability depends on the AI component and intended use.
Access estimates include consultation screening; employee consultation under national rules may extend the schedule.
unknowns: Available exposure history, loss observations, and licensed market data.
Existing calculation tools, connectors, and deployment controls.
Who can provide sufficiently independent model review.
Whether the model affects natural persons or regulated credit decisions.
Applicable employee consultation requirements and access lead times.
research_questions: Which established model family matches the intended decision and available observations?
What challenger method and holdout period would reveal material weaknesses?
Can existing system configuration satisfy the specification before custom implementation?
new_work: Resolve source-data exceptions and maintain mappings.
Review failed tests and changes in model behaviour.
Maintain calculation libraries, release evidence, and access controls.

tasks.short: Design severe market scenarios and assess their financial effects.

steps.what: Gather current exposures, cash forecasts, and relevant market observations.
Select severe events, transmission channels, and combinations relevant to the business.
Set numerical shocks, timing, dependencies, and assumptions about management responses.
Calculate stressed valuations, cash flows, covenant headroom, and sensitivities.
Assess vulnerabilities, model limitations, and feasible responses to the stressed outcomes.
Assemble scenario assumptions, result tables, charts, limitations, and recommendations into a brief.
Challenge the scenarios and endorse conclusions for planning.

tasks.design: A scenario workbench on the {DATA_PLATFORM} combines reconciled {ERP} and {BANK} exposures with structured, specialist-authored shocks. Deterministic calculations feed a {BI} comparison view and a template-generated brief in the {DOCS}; endorsement is recorded in the {WORKFLOW}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Exposure refreshes, linked calculation files, and repeated pack assembly made scenario iterations expensive. Choosing credible severity and interacting shocks was never a simple automation problem.
tasks.enabler_now: AI-assisted coding makes scenario forms, reusable calculation engines, and report templates cheaper to build. No language model is needed to calculate losses or choose shock magnitudes.
tasks.still_hard: Tail events offer limited calibration data. Correlations can break, counterparties can react, and assumed management actions may fail under stress.
tasks.human_edge: Imagining a coherent adverse event and challenging responses that look feasible only under normal conditions.

ambition.what: Weekly review of liquidity-buffer adequacy against a refreshed severe-market scenario.

tasks.altitude: The specialist spends more time testing alternative responses with the treasurer and less time refreshing packs. Funding and hedge approval rights require explicit delegation.

reach.task: Assess available funding and liquidity responses under stress.
reach.learn: Facility draw conditions, collateral calls, covenant definitions, and execution lead times.

evidence.claim: Given explicit shocks and valuation rules, scenario calculations and report assembly can be deterministic.
Selecting severe events and plausible management responses remains judgement-intensive; faster calculation does not establish scenario validity.
The documented spreadsheet benchmark reports a cash-waterfall error, supporting independent reconciliation of financial calculations.

assumptions: The pilot covers corporate liquidity and market exposures with existing valuation methods.
Scenario design retains substantial human effort despite the supplied automation prior.
The calculation engine stops affected outputs when required inputs or reconciliation checks fail.
Estimates assume reuse of released models and an existing governed data environment.
GDPR applies to personal data; assess EU AI Act applicability if AI components are introduced.
Access estimates include consultation screening; national rules determine whether employee consultation is needed.
unknowns: Exposure refresh frequency and availability of reliable cash forecasts.
Instrument complexity and availability of approved valuation methods.
Which covenant and facility terms are already structured.
Who endorses scenarios and who can authorise financial responses.
Market-data licence restrictions and consultation requirements.
research_questions: Can existing calculation capabilities support parameterised shocks before custom code is built?
Which reverse-stress thresholds would expose the most useful vulnerabilities?
Which management responses remain executable during simultaneous market and funding stress?
new_work: Maintain scenario parameters and exposure mappings.
Investigate failed valuations and stale inputs.
Revisit dependencies and response assumptions after market events.

tasks.short: Design controls that detect when risk assessments become unreliable.

steps.what: Identify risk assessments, intended uses, owners, and potential failure modes.
Define validity measures, thresholds, review intervals, and escalation conditions.
Match historical predictions to realised outcomes and resolve timing or identifier differences.
Configure validity calculations, monitoring views, and breach indicators.
Replay known failures and challenge monitoring coverage, thresholds, and false alarms.
Approve monitoring activation, response responsibilities, and escalation authority.
Publish the approved monitoring schedule and notify responsible owners.

tasks.design: Deterministic matching on the {DATA_PLATFORM} connects assessment versions to outcomes from the {ERP} and produces a reconciled monitoring dataset. Configured views in the {BI} show approved validity measures, while the {WORKFLOW} routes breaches and overdue reviews to named owners without automatically closing them or changing models.
tasks.previous_blocker: Predictions and outcomes often lacked shared identifiers and consistent observation windows. Building reliable monitoring required data engineering and agreement on what constitutes failure.
tasks.enabler_now: AI-assisted coding reduces the cost of matching pipelines and historical replay tests. Existing {BI} and {WORKFLOW} configuration can provide most presentation and routing.
tasks.still_hard: Delayed outcomes, small samples, and changing populations can make apparent deterioration ambiguous. Threshold design must balance missed failures against alert fatigue.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguishing a temporary data problem from a model limitation that should restrict business use.

ambition.what: Early-warning review of customer-credit models used by business units without dedicated risk analysts.

tasks.altitude: The specialist spends more time investigating weak assessments across business units and less time rebuilding monitoring evidence. The right to suspend a model requires explicit delegation.

reach.task: Build outcome-linked monitoring datasets and meaningful alert views.
reach.learn: Data lineage, observation windows, metric definitions, and dashboard usability.

evidence.claim: Outcome matching, scheduled validity calculations, and threshold routing can be deterministic once definitions are agreed.
DataSnipper supports financial evidence checks with human sign-off; this supports checking capability, not automated validity judgements.
Baker Tilly Netherlands reported reduced statement-checking time with DataSnipper; the case does not establish savings for risk monitoring.

assumptions: Assessment versions and realised outcomes can be retained and linked lawfully.
Existing {BI} supports the required monitoring views; calculation pipelines are built only where configuration is insufficient.
Estimates cover a small model inventory and reuse the model-release records.
GDPR applies to personal data, and EU AI Act obligations depend on the monitored system and use.
Consultation and access ranges include checking national rules; employee-level monitoring may require a longer process.
unknowns: Whether historical predictions and model versions were retained.
Outcome delays, sample sizes, and known failure examples.
Current monitoring capabilities and available licences.
Authority to restrict use, suspend a model, or accept a breach.
Whether monitoring includes employee behaviour or personal credit decisions.
research_questions: Which failure modes can be detected before financial outcomes become observable?
What historical replay would expose silent failures in the monitoring itself?
Which alerts need investigation rather than a fixed threshold response?
new_work: Investigate matching exceptions and missing outcomes.
Triage breaches and document their disposition.
Maintain thresholds, ownership, and historical replay cases.

tasks.short: Document material financial risks and communicate their implications to decision makers.

steps.what: Collect current exposures, limit breaches, stress results, and open risk actions.
Request explanations, changes, and mitigation updates from risk owners.
Explain risk developments, mitigation progress, and unresolved uncertainties.
Decide which risks are material, urgent, or require a management decision.
Draft the risk report with evidence, implications, uncertainties, and proposed actions.

loop.input: Selected risk evidence, owner notes, priorities, and a fixed report template.
loop.output: Draft narrative with source references and explicit uncertainty markers; figures inserted by deterministic code.
loop.check: Validate numerical fields against the evidence pack, require references for factual claims, and flag unsupported or contradictory statements for specialist review.
loop.stop: One draft and one repair pass per report; missing evidence or unresolved contradictions return to the specialist without publication.
loop.why_not_simpler: Tables and standard sections are templated, but varied owner explanations require concise, context-sensitive prose.

steps.what: Approve the report's conclusions, audience, and disclosure scope.
Distribute the approved report and request acknowledgement from designated recipients.
Explain implications, challenge assumptions, and agree actions with decision makers.
Copy agreed actions, owners, and deadlines into the tracking workbook.

tasks.design: The {WORKFLOW} gathers structured owner updates, while the {DATA_PLATFORM} assembles reconciled evidence and inserts verified figures into a report template in the {DOCS}. A bounded drafting loop proposes the narrative; approved versions and audiences control distribution through the {WORKFLOW}, and actions are captured directly in the {PROJECT} during discussion.
tasks.previous_blocker: Evidence collection, mailbox chasing, and copying figures into reports were fragmented. Owner explanations varied too much for useful prose to come from fixed templates alone.
tasks.enabler_now: Configured update forms and distribution flows handle coordination. A bounded model can draft from selected evidence while deterministic code controls figures and report versions.
tasks.still_hard: Materiality, uncertainty, and politically difficult messages need accountable judgement. Acknowledgement does not prove understanding or commitment to act.
tasks.human_edge: Making a risk understandable enough that decision makers confront the trade-off and commit to a credible response.

ambition.what: Monthly financial-risk briefings for operational budget holders.

tasks.altitude: The week shifts toward explaining emerging risks and testing proposed mitigations with operational managers. Report approval and risk-acceptance rights remain subject to explicit delegation.

reach.task: Translate financial-risk scenarios into budget contingencies.
reach.learn: Operational cost drivers, controllable spending, and timing of contingency decisions.

evidence.claim: Moody's Credit Memo drafts financial memos from spreads, deal documents, and templates; this supports adjacent report-drafting capability.
The unnamed European bank drafting claim is vendor-reported and does not establish savings or accuracy for this risk-report workflow.
Structured update requests, approved-recipient distribution, and direct action capture can use configured workflows.

assumptions: The baseline report is internal; external or statutory disclosures need their own authorisation path.
The estimate assumes an existing evidence dataset, report template, and access-controlled document store.
Discussion time includes capturing agreed actions directly, allowing later workbook copying to disappear.
The model receives only authorised evidence; GDPR applies where personal data are included.
EU AI Act applicability is assessed for the intended use, and national rules govern any required employee consultation.
unknowns: Current report audiences, approval routes, and disclosure restrictions.
Availability and quality of risk-owner updates.
Whether outputs include personal data or confidential third-party information.
Whether existing licences support structured updates and acknowledgement tracking.
Required employee consultation and permitted model-processing environment.
research_questions: Which report sections can be generated entirely from fixed fields and templates?
Can reviewers detect omitted uncertainties and contradictions in a representative report sample?
Which audience decisions should each report explicitly support?
new_work: Review narrative claims, omitted uncertainties, and source references.
Maintain templates, recipient permissions, and update forms.
Handle overdue updates, failed deliveries, and unresolved action ownership.

role.altitude: The role moves toward model challenge, scenario design, and decision-focused risk advice as data preparation and reporting shrink. Authority to change limits, execute hedges, accept risks, or suspend models requires explicit delegation.
reach: Treasurers and Controllers: connect stressed exposures to executable liquidity and funding responses.
Business Intelligence Analysts: build outcome-linked monitoring with clear lineage.
Data Scientists: strengthen validation, uncertainty analysis, and reproducibility.
Budget Analysts: turn risk findings into practical contingency choices.
skills_to_grow: Reproducible financial calculations and reconciliation controls.
Model validation, uncertainty, and limits of historical evidence.
Scenario design and reverse stress testing.
Data lineage, access controls, and workflow configuration.
Evidence-based drafting review and clear risk communication.
role.ambitious_version: Provide an internal financial-risk advisory service that tests proposed transactions, refreshes liquidity scenarios, and helps operational managers choose credible contingencies.
